What is CSS and what is it used for?

CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is a stylesheet language used to describe the presentation of HTML documents. It controls layout, colors, fonts, spacing, animations, and responsive design. CSS separates content from presentation, allowing developers to style multiple pages consistently. Current standard is CSS3, which introduced flexbox, grid, animations, transitions, custom properties (variables), and media queries.

What is CSS Grid Layout? Show grid container properties like grid-template-columns, grid-template-rows, gap, and grid item placement.

```css /* ===== CSS GRID LAYOUT COMPLETE GUIDE ===== */ /* GRID CONTAINER PROPERTIES */ .grid-container { display: grid; /* 1. Defining columns and rows */ grid-template-columns: 200px 300px 200px; /* 3 fixed columns */ grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr 1fr; /* fractional units */ grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); /* 4 equal columns */ grid-template-columns: auto auto auto; /* based on content */ grid-template-columns: minmax(100px, 1fr) 2fr; /* responsive */ grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr)); /* responsive grid */ grid-template-rows: 100px auto 100px; /* fixed, auto, fixed */ grid-template-rows: repeat(3, minmax(50px, auto)); /* 2. Gap between grid items */ gap: 20px; /* both row and column gaps */ row-gap: 15px; /* vertical gap */ column-gap: 30px; /* horizontal gap */ /* 3. Aligning grid tracks */ justify-content: center; /* align grid horizontally in container */ align-content: center; /* align grid vertically in container */ /* 4. Aligning items inside cells */ justify-items: stretch; /* horizontal alignment (default) */ justify-items: center; justify-items: start; justify-items: end; align-items: stretch; /* vertical alignment (default) */ align-items: center; align-items: start; align-items: end; /* 5. Named grid areas (awesome for layouts) */ grid-template-areas: "header header header" "sidebar main main" "footer footer footer"; } /* GRID ITEM PROPERTIES */ .grid-item { /* Placement by line numbers */ grid-column-start: 1; grid-column-end: 3; /* spans columns 1-2 */ grid-row-start: 2; grid-row-end: 4; /* spans rows 2-3 */ /* Shorthand */ grid-column: 1 / 3; /* start at line 1, end at line 3 */ grid-row: 2 / 4; /* Span keyword */ grid-column: span 2; /* span 2 columns */ grid-row: span 3; /* span 3 rows */ /* Using named grid areas */ grid-area: header; /* places item in header area */ /* Override container alignment for single item */ justify-self: center; /* override justify-items */ align-self: end; /* override align-items */ } ``` ```html
